title: Gomez injury overshadows winning start for Iraola
summary: Liverpool begins the Andoni Iraola era with a commanding 4-2 victory over Sunderland, with goals from Morrison, Szoboszlai, Chiesa, and Koumas. However, an injury to Gomez during the match tempers the promising start.
content: Liverpool start life under Andoni Iraola with a 4-2 win over Sunderland thanks to goals from Kieran Morrison, Dominik Szoboszlai, Federico Chiesa and Lewis Koumas.

title: Wilson makes Leeds debut in defeat by Wrexham

content: Wales attacking midfielder Harry Wilson makes his first outing for Leeds United as they are beaten 3-2 by Wrexham in the club's opening pre-season game.
